meta.title: Kvist Cloud — your own machine with an agent
meta.description: A cloud machine with Kvist on it. Paste your model key, write a task, pay only for the hours the agent works.

reason.hours_exhausted: Your hours ran out. Buy more and press Continue: the task picks up where it stopped.
reason.provider_unavailable: The model provider did not answer for 5 minutes. The meter stopped. Press Continue when it is back.
reason.invalid_key: The model provider refused your key. Change it in Settings, then press Continue.
reason.command_time_limit: A command ran longer than your plan allows, so the task was stopped. Press Continue to go on.
reason.machine_restarted: The machine restarted. Nothing is lost: press Continue.
reason.machine_sleeping: The machine went to sleep. Press Continue.
reason.user: You paused it. Press Continue when you want.
reason.agent_error: The agent hit an error and stopped. The events above say what happened.
reason.clone_failed: The repository could not be cloned. Check that the link opens and the repository is public.
reason.repo_not_allowed: That repository link is not allowed.
reason.start_failed: Kvist did not start on the machine.
reason.resume_failed: There was nothing to continue from.
reason.no_key: There is no model key. Add one in Settings.

errors.not_signed_in: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.no_hours: Your hours are used up. Buy more on the dashboard.
errors.bad_repo: That does not look like a repository link. It should start with https://
errors.machine_offline: The machine is not reachable right now. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.machine_busy: A task is running on this machine.
errors.not_paused: Only a paused task can continue.
errors.not_waiting: The agent is not waiting for an answer any more.
errors.csrf: The page is out of date. Reload it.
errors.network: No connection to the server. Check your internet and try again.
errors.github_unreachable: GitHub is not answering. Try again in a minute.
errors.billing_unavailable: Billing is not answering. Try again in a minute.
errors.oauth_failed: GitHub did not confirm the sign-in. Try again.
errors.oauth_state: The sign-in link expired. Start again.
errors.not_found: This page does not exist or is not yours.

keyCheck.invalid_key: This key is wrong. Copy it again from the provider's keys page.
keyCheck.no_funds: The key works, but the provider's balance is empty. Top it up there.
keyCheck.rate_limited: The provider limits requests right now. Wait a minute and paste again.
keyCheck.provider_down: The provider is not answering. Try again in a minute.
keyCheck.bad_endpoint: That address does not answer like an OpenAI-compatible API (it needs https).
keyCheck.model_not_found: This endpoint does not serve that model.

pricing.title: Your own cloud machine with an agent on it
pricing.lede: Paste your model key, write a task, and Kvist does it on the machine. The machine sleeps between tasks. You pay for the hours the agent works.
pricing.terms: In 7 days, $15 a month. Cancel in one click at any time.
pricing.github: You sign in with GitHub. No password, no forms, no email to confirm.
how: The meter runs only while the agent works: thinks, waits for the model, runs a command.
Waiting for your answer, paused, done, a sleeping machine: free.
Billed per second, shown in whole minutes, rounded down.
If your hours run out mid-task, the task pauses. Nothing is deleted.

start.title: Attach a card for the trial
start.terms: Nothing is charged today. 7 days and 5 agent hours are free, then Start costs $15 a month. Cancel in one click in Settings.
start.confirming: Waiting for the payment provider to confirm the card…
start.stubNote: Payments are switched off on this server. This is where the Paddle form opens.
start.machineCreating: Your machine is being prepared meanwhile.
start.machineError: Your machine could not be prepared. We will try again when you start a task.

onboarding.title: Your first task
onboarding.repoNoList: No public repositories to show. Paste a link instead.
presets: Explain the structure of this project
Run the tests and fix the failing ones
Find and fix the bug from the latest issue
onboarding.goalPlaceholder: Describe the task in your own words
onboarding.needKey: Add a working key above to run the task.
onboarding.needGoal: Write a task or pick one of the three.
onboarding.machineError: Machine needs a retry: starting the task retries it

task.waitingTitle: The agent is waiting for you
task.waitingBody: Hours are not counted while it waits.
task.archiveFailed: The archive could not be made. Try again.
task.stopBody: The agent stops after its current step. What it changed stays on the machine.
task.queuedNote: Waiting for a free slot: your plan runs a set number of tasks at once. It starts by itself, free until then.
task.startingNote: The machine is starting the agent…
task.emptyFeed: Nothing yet: the agent is getting ready.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.trialBanner: In 2 days we will charge ${price}. If you do not want to continue, cancel in Settings: one click.
dashboard.noMachine: No machine yet. It is created when you start a task.
dashboard.disputeBody: Tell us what went wrong. A person reads it and answers by email; a refund comes back as a separate line here.
dashboard.disputeSent: Sent. We will answer by email.

settings.title: Settings
settings.trialUntil: Free trial until {date}, then Start for ${price} a month.
settings.cancelledUntil: Cancelled. Access until {date}; nothing more will be charged.
settings.cancelBody: You keep access until {date}. Nothing more will be charged.
settings.deleteTitle: Delete the machine and its files?
settings.deleteBody: Everything on its disk goes away. Export an archive first if you need the files.
